english.title: Fail to give officer right of access for inspection of aircraft or documents relating to aircraft / goods / passengers
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), failed to give an officer, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OFFICER..), the right of access required to a place to which access was required for the purposes of an inspection of

(A)_[an aircraft,]_
(B)_[goods, namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..), loaded in an aircraft,]_
(C)_[all documents relating to the aircraft,]_
(D)_[all documents relating to goods carried in the aircraft,]_
(E)_[all documents relating to persons carried in an aircraft,]_
(F)_[**(..WHERE MORE THAN ONE OF THE ABOVE OPTIONS IS REQUIRED - SPECIFY..),]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE AIRCRAFT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 33(1) and (4) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
